column1: # 003 SC-004: words split across a line end, as PDFium gives them (U+0002 where the
# line-end hyphen was). kind<TAB>split (| = line end)<TAB>expected word.
# ordinary: the hyphen only marks the break, so the parts must be joined.
# compound: a real hyphen sits at the break, so the word must not be joined.
